item.title: Attachable 1.0.6
item.description:
### Attachable 1.0.6
- The right-click actions now show they're working: a progress bar under the file or folder in Finder, and a small box at the top right of the screen ("Compressing 7 of 100…"). - A clearer message when something can't fit one email: how small it got, and what to do instead. - Small fixes.
